svg.title: backplane
svg.text: XB2: socket for B2 (PORTS B + METERS)
W1: QT lead S1: pins from the front, soldered on the copper side
W2: QT lead S2: pins from the front, soldered on the copper side
W3: QT lead S3: pins from the front, soldered on the copper side
W4: QT lead S4: pins from the front, soldered on the copper side
XJ1: charger I2C pins (lead to EVM J8)
Backplane: BusBoard PAD3U padboard cut 21 x 39 holes, seen from the front (component side); a pad per hole, no strips: the bus wires on the copper side join them
Line: what its bus wire carries
16: spare bus line (for the charger interrupt)
small square: a pin in a hole
coloured line: tinned bus wire on the copper side, ringed where soldered
purple ring: a lead soldered on the copper side
dashed: the mux, behind on foam
